def solve():
    rev = Q(4140000)
    cogs = rev * Q("0.56")
    recv_rel = rev * 14 / 365
    inv_base = cogs * 39 / 365
    inv_tgt = cogs * 74 / 365
    inv_rel = inv_base - inv_tgt
    purchases = cogs + (inv_tgt - inv_base)
    pay_base = cogs * 40 / 365
    pay_tgt = purchases * 30 / 365
    pay_rise = pay_tgt - pay_base
    total = recv_rel + inv_rel + pay_rise
    return {
        "final": total,
        "receivables_release": recv_rel,
        "inventory_release": inv_rel,
        "program_year_purchases": purchases,
        "payables_financing": pay_rise,
    }
